title: Englisch 6 Gymnasium (ZAM Academy)
description: English at Bavarian Gymnasium grade 6 (first foreign language): 40 lessons on future tenses, past progressive, present perfect, adjective comparison, relative clauses, conditional I, Cornwall, Lake District, Roman Britain and US regions, with 120 recall cards. Listening, live talk and current research need extra practice.
